## About
California Star is a German auto repair shop at 3344 Mount Diablo Blvd in Lafayette. We focus on luxury and high-end vehicles like Mercedes, Audi and BMW, and we help neighbors from Lafayette, Walnut Creek, Orinda, Moraga and the rest of the Bay Area.
Owner Bill Gunnett leads a small team that includes Chris Tecco, our Mercedes and BMW specialist, and Dane Loveridge. Our first step is always to listen, then give you the information you need to make a good decision, without selling you work you don't need.
We were the first "Green Shop" in Contra Costa County, recognized by the Department of Toxic Substances Control. Customers have given us a 5 rating across 129 Google reviews, and we're open Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Engine diagnostic and repair: Finding the real cause of warning lights, rough running and other engine trouble, then fixing it.
- Maintenance and tune ups: Routine maintenance and tune ups to keep your German car running well.
- Extended warranty service: We offer extended warranty service.
- Insurance coordinating when a vehicle is damaged: If your car is damaged, we help coordinate with your insurance and assist you through the process.
- Evaluations on potential car purchases: Thinking about buying a car? We'll evaluate it and give you our recommendation.

## FAQ
Q: Which makes do you work on?
A: We specialize in Audi, BMW, MINI, Mercedes-Benz and Volkswagen.

Q: How does drop-off work?
A: Drop your car off in the morning and plan to leave it with us for the day.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. Local ride service is available through Lyft Concierge.

Q: Do you offer pick up for senior customers?
A: Yes, we offer pick up and delivery for our senior customers. Give us a call to set it up.
